hydraflight.name: Hydra Flight
hydraflight.desc: Full local Levitate and Hydra Bond. Ground immunity can be bypassed normally; Hydra Bond remains active. Eligible attacks retain three hits, 30% follow-ups, spread and Free-for-All rules, the full-power Gilded Helix exception and Dragon Den power boost. No Berserk boosts.

worldbreaker.name: Worldbreaker
worldbreaker.shortDesc: Berserk + Duskilate; 30% double power per hit, except Fickle Beam.
worldbreaker.desc: Full local Berserk and Duskilate. Surviving a move crossing half HP grants +1 Attack and Sp. Atk; Dragon Den entry grants +2 to both. Each damaging hit independently has a 30% chance to double base power, except Fickle Beam uses only its own all-out roll. No Merciless critical-hit bonus.

falseliberation.name: False Liberation
falseliberation.shortDesc: Mold Breaker; once each switch-in, a Dark hit stops the foe repeating its last move.
falseliberation.desc: Has Mold Breaker. Once each switch-in, a Dark attack that damages a foe directly applies Torment if it survives: it cannot use the same move twice in a row. Only successfully applying Torment spends the use. It does not refresh an existing Torment.
